pwa.installDescription: Install the app for quick access to expenses and approvals on this device.
pwa.installDescriptionTenant: Install your organization app for one-tap sign-in and expense submissions.
pwa.installDescriptionMarketing: Install the PesoWise app for faster access to the platform.
pwa.installUnavailableHint: Use your browser's install option to add PesoWise to this device.
pwa.chromeStep1: Chrome / Edge: click the install icon in the address bar (⊕ or monitor with arrow).
pwa.chromeStep2: If you don't see it, open the menu (⋮) → Install app / Save and share → Install.
pwa.androidStep1: Chrome on Android: tap the menu (⋮) → Install app or Add to Home screen.
pwa.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari (square with arrow).
pwa.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
pwa.iosStep3: Tap Add — the app icon will appear on your home screen.
pwa.installBlockedDescription: This page's app details did not match this address. Reload the page and try again; if it keeps happening, contact your administrator.
